TEST_DB_PASSWORD=<password> ./gradlew check` |	a usage line: the password is the <password> placeholder, passed through the environment
README.md	| Run locally with sample data | `SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=local DB_URL=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/<db> DB_USERNAME=... SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD=<password> OPEN_PRODUCTS_SEED_ENABLED=true ./gradlew bootRun`. The startup TLS check is on by default (`fintechbankx.tls.enforce`: every JDBC URL `sslmode=verify-full` with the RDS CA bundle); only the `local` profile and the test resources switch it off, and the chart refuses both |	a usage line: the password is the <password> placeholder, passed through the environment
